description: Screenshot of Q drop text on a lavender background (attached to Q post 3959, ca. late March 2020), possibly cropped at the top. The drop raises questions about the Wuhan Institute of Virology and COVID-19's origin, quotes the DOJ press release on Harvard professor Charles Lieber's China ties, links Epoch Times and Twitter posts by Tom Fitton and Sen. Tom Cotton, and lists claimed political effects of the virus on the 2020 election (ending Trump rallies/economic gains, sheltering Biden, vote by mail), ending with a statement of Occam's razor. These are the drop's claims, not established facts.

What is the mathematical probability this occurs [the ‘time bomb’ explodes] at the exact point in time that allows for maximum damage [above] prior to the P_elec? Outside of standard deviation? description: Screenshot of a Donald Trump retweet-with-comment of a Dan Scavino tweet (dated Mar 8, ca. March 2020). Scavino's tweet is a meme photoshopping Trump's face onto a violinist, captioned with the Q slogan 'Nothing can stop what's coming.' Trump's quote comment reads 'Who knows what this means, but it sounds good to me!' Engagement counts are visible.

description: Photograph of a U.S. flag on a flagpole, apparently at the stern of a boat, backlit by a low sun over a lake or bay with hills on the horizon. The sun shines through the semi-transparent flag so that the light forms a cross shape in the union/stripes area, a widely shared patriotic-religious image. Location and photographer are not identified.
flags: The cross-shaped light may be a natural sun-through-fabric effect or digital editing; cannot be verified

description: 'Q proof' graphic on a black background pairing a screenshot of Q drop 3784 (Jan 23 2020, about DECLAS, Barr and the Durham investigation, containing 'Nothing can stop what is coming') with a Gateway Pundit article of April 11 2020 by Cristina Laila reporting, via John Solomon, that Durham had subpoenaed witnesses before a DC grand jury. The layout claims the article validates the earlier Q drop. Headline text 'Q PROOF:' and 'PROOFS ARE IMPORTANT — Q' frame the composition.
text: Q PROOF:. Q !!Hs1Jq13jV6 ID: 8cdd1a No.7884016. 3784. Jan 23 2020 01:57:08 (EST). DECLAS CoC. POTUS > Barr. Barr > Durham. [[F] classified intel provided [FVEY - Non FVEY] as needed]. Does Durham want to hold [freeze] 'public' declas due to criminal nature of the probe(s)?. Think GJ material. When did the investigation begin?. When did the investigation really begin?. Nothing can stop what is coming. Nothing. Slow drip > Flood. Q. GATEWAY PUNDIT. We report the truth — and leave the Russia-Collusion fairy tale to the Conspiracy media. HUGE! Via John Solomon: Durham Has Subpoenaed and Called in Witnesses Before a DC Grand Jury. By Cristina Laila. Published April 11, 2020 at 9:10pm. US Attorney General Bill Barr appointed US Attorney from Connecticut John Durham last May to investigate the origins of Spygate. Award-winning investigative reporter John Solomon told Sean Hannity on Friday's podcast that he knows of a few witnesses who have appeared before a DC grand jury. John Solomon told Hannity he believes that Durham's charges will start with Kevin Clinesmith, the lawyer who fraudulently changed a document to deceive the FISA court. PROOFS ARE IMPORTANT — Q
flags: The 'Q proof' framing asserts an unverified predictive connection between the Q drop and later news; documented as the graphic's claim only
Gateway Pundit reporting and John Solomon's claims are presented as the article's assertions, not established fact
